title: Ashen Delta: The Navigator's Tide Ledger
premise: In a marsh where glass reeds record vanished flood levels, the navigator must synchronize the return route to the signal using a star-and-current sextant.
ending: Recover the Tide Ledger and return with the verified return bearing; Delta Ferrymen can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive silt lightning while evading the drowned warden without sacrificing the verified return bearing.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Delta Ferrymen to witness the star-and-current sextant.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to accept an unverified coordinate
